correctness.rationale: The 48-member pair-preserving wreath product is pairwise even-intersecting because every difference fixes a union of whole pairs. The 720-vertex real symmetric central Cayley matrix with weights 3 and 2 on one-fixed-point conjugacy classes has constant row sum 672 and all irreducible eigenvalues explicitly derived; minimum -48, multiplicities sum to 720. The exact Hoffman inequality 0 >= a(a-48) proves a <=48. The standalone program checks every representation character twice by distinct algorithms, class cardinalities and all subgroup pairs. Computation supports, not substitutes for, the mathematical eigenvalue proof.
